target.statement: ROC AUC of kNNW with probabilistic (exponential) normalization on the TwoLeadECG dataset (or any single DAMI/UTSD dataset) matches the unnormalized kNNW ROC AUC, demonstrating ranking stability of the probabilistic transformation.
target.table_ref: Figure 4 (ROC AUC per dataset, probability distribution comparison); Table 1 lists datasets
target.dataset: TwoLeadECG (UTSD) or a small DAMI dataset such as Hepatitis/Parkinson

compute.basis: kNNW is brute-force kNN on small tabular/time-series datasets (N up to ~7000, d up to ~2700); a single dataset with k sweep 1-100 and 2-fold CV is minutes of CPU, plus install/download time.

blockers: Paper reports results only as figures (no numeric table cells), so exact value must be read off plots
UTSD/DAMI datasets need to be fetched from external collections (UTSD archive, ELKI/DAMI library) not bundled with the repo
Repo may not include exact experiment configs/scripts for the figure
title: A Probabilistic Transformation of Distance-Based Outliers
